description: Massachusetts Solid Waste Facilities, 1994 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Harvard Map Collection, U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of the Census. This datalayer is a polygon coverage displaying Solid Waste Facilities throughout Massachusetts. The data here were originally produced by MassGIS. The Solid Waste Facility Datalayer was compiled by the Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) Division of Solid Waste Management to track the locations of landfills, transfer stations, and combustion facilities. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational, non-commercial use only. Although this data set has been developed by the Harvard Map Collection and its partners, no warranty expres. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
